title: Commissioning Manager
summary: Lead commissioning of mission-critical infrastructure projects from planning and testing through validation.
description: Lead commissioning of mission-critical infrastructure projects from planning and testing through validation.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Conduct system testing and performance verification for reliability and compliance.
Maintain commissioning records, test scripts and change logs; manage specialist equipment.
Plan and oversee factory and on-site tests, procedures, schedules and subcontractors.
Lead commissioning engineers and provide weekly progress and risk reports.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: 5+ years in a senior commissioning role.
Experience with PLCs and identifying software bugs during commissioning.
Unrestricted right to work in UK and EU without sponsorship.
